title: Today's a Good Day for a Warm Bento

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer. Going to eat lunch?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I made it together with my
breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of lunches Wonder
Acute makes. My imagination
(or stomach)
starts running wild.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Say, if you haven't had lunch yet, would
you like to join me? I could
use some help.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sure as can be. I made a bit too much
today, so I'd be delighted if
you'd take
some of it off my plate.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, <username>! A
bunch of us were about to grab lunch, you
want in? Apparently the new ramen place
by the
station is pretty good.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Trainer, you don't have to decline on
my account.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure we'll have plenty more chances to
share a bento again. If your
company's
wanted, you ought to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've already made up my mind. Thanking
him for the invite, I explain to the other
trainer that I have plans to eat lunch
with
Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, okay, didn't know you already had
plans. Catch you next time,
then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute lifts the lid off her
bento to reveal a meal of Western
home cooking:
bacon and cheese sandwiches with
meatloaf.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It all looks tempting,
but a sandwich is my
first victim. The thick slices of bacon
harmonize perfectly with the tomatoes and
fragrant slices of rye bread.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, my! Seeing such a look of delight on
your face just warms my heart. Try the tea
too. I put it in a thermos,
so it's nice and
steamy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I take a few sips of tea,
the fragrance of
the leaves fills my nostrils.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And for dessert, there's a cherry pie with
your name on it. You can
have as much as
you like.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, now that was a satisfying meal. And
the sun... is shining just
right...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Days like this make you want to lie around
in the sun and take a nice
nap.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chirp, chirp!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the birds are out. Look at that,
what a
cozy place for a nest. The
little ones look
full of life.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for spending time with
me. And I'm sorry you had
to turn down
that invitation.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you don't have to pretend. You
really are the most considerate
person,
you know that?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just like you did now, you always find a
way to put me first in your
mind. Looking
back,
it's been like that ever since we met.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You noticed my quirk right away and
suggested a better way I could
be
stretching.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You looked at me with those keen eyes of
yours and made a training
plan tailored
just so to my needs.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And to think, I get to have such an
incredible person as my trainer—I
count
my blessings every single day.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I think it would do you
some good to take things at
your own
pace too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When I see you going about your business
nice and slow, that's what
really brings a
smile to my face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ding, dong...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well,
time sure flies by. I'll see you after
school, then. Remember not
to overwork
yourself, you hear?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad she's looking out for me, but it
sounds like there's a
misunderstanding that
needs clearing up.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Well,
there's no rush. If we just take things
at our own pace, I'm sure
we'll grow to
understand one another in time.
